title: A Toom rule that increases the thickness of sets
notes: Proves a monotone thickness functional for a Toom-type rule, useful as a shape-quality surrogate.

title: Universality for two-dimensional critical cellular automata
notes: Classifies critical monotone update families in 2D and proves universal threshold-order behavior.

title: Sum-difference exponents for boundedly many slopes, and rational complexity
notes: Shows boundedly many slopes drive exponents back toward 2 at a rate controlled by rational complexity.

title: Generalized Arithmetic Kakeya
notes: Introduces a higher-dimensional arithmetic Kakeya variant and strengthens sum-difference inequalities iteratively.
